<task type="auto" tdd="true">
  <name>Task 1: S3-backed ObjectStore with conditional create and list-less missing-key handling</name>
  <files>apps/api/src/s3.ts, apps/api/src/__tests__/s3.spec.ts</files>
  <read_first>
    - docs/specs/SPEC-storage-s3.md (2, 3, 5 IAM, 8 local development)
    - apps/api/src/object-store.ts, config.ts
    - .planning/phases/03-snapshot-share-end-to-end/03-RESEARCH.md (Pattern 1, Assumption A5)
  </read_first>
  <behavior>
    - s3ClientConfig with no S3_ENDPOINT sets region and credentials and no endpoint or forcePathStyle
    - s3ClientConfig with S3_ENDPOINT sets endpoint, forcePathStyle true, requestChecksumCalculation and responseChecksumValidation 'WHEN_REQUIRED'
    - putIfAbsent sends a PutObjectCommand whose input has Bucket, Key, IfNoneMatch '*', ContentType, ContentEncoding 'gzip' and Metadata, and resolves true on success
    - putIfAbsent resolves false when send rejects with httpStatusCode 412 (PreconditionFailed) or 409 (ConditionalRequestConflict); rejects on 500
    - get returns { body bytes, contentType, contentEncoding, metadata } from GetObject; returns null on 404 NoSuchKey and on 403 AccessDenied; rejects on 500
    - head returns { contentLength, metadata } from HeadObject; returns null on 404 and 403
    - delete sends DeleteObjectCommand with Bucket and Key
  </behavior>
  <action>
Specs first with a fake client (`{ send: vi.fn() }` cast to `S3Client`), asserting `command instanceof PutObjectCommand` and `command.input`. Then `apps/api/src/s3.ts`:
- `s3ClientConfig(config: AppConfig): S3ClientConfig`: region `S3_REGION`, credentials from the two AWS keys. When `S3_ENDPOINT` is set, add `endpoint`, `forcePathStyle: true`, `requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED'` and `responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED'`, because S3-compatible stores reject the SDK's default trailing checksums.
- `S3ObjectStore implements ObjectStore`, constructor `(client: S3Client, bucket: string)`:
  - `get` uses GetObjectCommand with `Body.transformToByteArray()`, `Metadata ?? {}`.
  - `putIfAbsent` uses PutObjectCommand with `IfNoneMatch: '*'`.
  - `head` uses HeadObjectCommand with `ContentLength ?? 0`.
  - `delete` uses DeleteObjectCommand.
  - Classify errors by `$metadata.httpStatusCode`: 412/409 on put means false; 404/403 on get/head means null. Keep a one-line comment on the 403 mapping: the API credential has no list permission (SEC-04), so S3 answers 403 for a missing key.
- `createS3ObjectStore(config)` builds `new S3ObjectStore(new S3Client(s3ClientConfig(config)), config.S3_BUCKET)`.
No list command anywhere in this file.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm --filter @dossier/schema build && pnpm --filter api exec vitest run src/__tests__/s3.spec.ts</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "No test files found" in the output</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The command passes and every behavior bullet has an `it(...)`.
    - `rg -q "IfNoneMatch: '\*'" apps/api/src/s3.ts` exits 0.
    - `rg -q 'ListObjects|ListBucket' apps/api/src/s3.ts apps/api/src/object-store.ts apps/api/src/routes` exits 1.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>A production ObjectStore exists that never overwrites on create and treats a list-less 403 as a missing object.</done>
</task>

1. `apps/api/src/logger.ts`: `createLogger(level = 'info')` returns a pino logger with `redact: { paths: ['req.headers.authorization', 'ownerToken', '*.ownerToken', 'payload', '*.payload'], remove: true }`, typed as `AppLogger`-compatible. This is defense in depth; 03-02's middleware already logs only route patterns.
2. `apps/api/src/server.ts`:
   - `loadConfig(process.env)`. On `ConfigError`, write the error message (key names only) to stderr and `process.exit(1)`.
   - Create the logger from `LOG_LEVEL`. `const store = createS3ObjectStore(config)`. `createApp({ config, store, logger, version: process.env['RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA'] ?? 'dev' })`.
   - `serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: config.PORT, hostname: '0.0.0.0' }, (info) => logger.info({ port: info.port }, 'listening'))` from `@hono/node-server`.
   - On SIGTERM and SIGINT, close the server, then exit 0.
3. `docker-compose.yml` (repo root, D-16):
   - Service `minio`: image `quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z`, command `server /data --console-address :9001`, ports 9000 and 9001, `MINIO_ROOT_USER`/`MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD` minioadmin, healthcheck `mc ready local` every 5 s, 10 retries.
   - Service `createbuckets`: image `quay.io/minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z`, depends on minio healthy, entrypoint runs `mc alias set local http://minio:9000 minioadmin minioadmin` then `mc mb --ignore-existing local/character-dossier-dev`.

<task type="auto">
  <name>Task 3: API container image, Railway config-as-code and a container smoke</name>
  <files>apps/api/Dockerfile, .dockerignore, apps/api/railway.json, apps/api/scripts/container-smoke.mjs, apps/api/package.json</files>
  <read_first>
    - docs/specs/SPEC-deployment.md (4 Railway settings and build)
    - apps/api/package.json, package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json
    - apps/api/scripts/smoke.mjs (PASS/FAIL style)
  </read_first>
  <action>
Discretion choice: a Dockerfile, not Nixpacks/Railpack. A workspace dependency on `@dossier/schema` needs the repo root as build context, which the monorepo guide only gets with the root directory unset.
1. `apps/api/Dockerfile` (build context = repo root):
   - `FROM node:22-alpine`, `ENV COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0`, `RUN corepack enable`, `WORKDIR /repo`.
   - Copy `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `tsconfig.base.json` and the three workspace manifests (`apps/api/package.json`, `apps/web/package.json`, `packages/schema/package.json`, so the frozen lockfile importers all resolve).
   - `RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter "api..."`, then copy `packages/schema` and `apps/api`, then `RUN pnpm --filter "api..." run build`.
   - `ENV NODE_ENV=production`, `USER node`, `CMD ["node", "apps/api/dist/server.js"]`.
2. `.dockerignore` (root): `**/node_modules`, `**/dist`, `**/.env`, `apps/web/.angular`, `.wrangler`, `.git`, `.planning`, `.gsd`, `.playwright-mcp`.
3. `apps/api/railway.json`:
   - `$schema` `https://railway.com/railway.schema.json`.
   - `build`: builder `DOCKERFILE`, dockerfilePath `apps/api/Dockerfile`, watchPatterns `apps/api/**`, `packages/schema/**`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
   - `deploy`: healthcheckPath `/healthz`, healthcheckTimeout 60, restartPolicyType `ON_FAILURE`.
   - The service's config file path is set to `/apps/api/railway.json` in 03-08.
4. `apps/api/scripts/container-smoke.mjs` (record()/PASS/FAIL style; add script `smoke:container`):
   - `docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t character-dossier-api:local .` from the repo root.
   - Run the image without env; expect a non-zero exit.
   - Run it detached with `--network host` and the MinIO env from `.env.example` values but `NODE_ENV=production`, `PORT=3099`, `RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED` unset.
   - Poll `http://127.0.0.1:3099/v1/shares/s0000000000000000000000000` until it answers (60 s cap); expect 404 with `error.code` NOT_FOUND and `X-Content-Type-Options` present only if 03-02 has landed (record as INFO, not FAIL, when absent).
   - Always `docker rm -f` the container.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm run minio:up && node apps/api/scripts/container-smoke.mjs</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or any output line starting with "FAIL"</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The command passes with PASS lines for image build, boot refusal without env, and the 404 envelope.
    - `node -e "const j=require('./apps/api/railway.json');if(j.build.builder!=='DOCKERFILE'||j.deploy.healthcheckPath!=='/healthz'||j.deploy.restartPolicyType!=='ON_FAILURE')process.exit(1)"` exits 0.
    - `rg -q 'frozen-lockfile' apps/api/Dockerfile` and `rg -q 'USER node' apps/api/Dockerfile` exit 0.
    - `docker ps -a --format '{{.Image}}' | rg -q 'character-dossier-api:local'` exits 1 after the smoke (container removed).
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>The API ships as a reproducible container that Railway can build from the monorepo, refuses a bad environment, and serves the share routes.</done>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| API process to S3 | credentialed object operations |
| repo to container image / Railway | build inputs and secrets |
| developer machine | local .env with credentials |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-03-03-01 | Tampering | concurrent create of the same key | high | mitigate | `IfNoneMatch '*'` on every create; 412/409 means false; unit and integration specs. |
| T-03-03-02 | Information Disclosure | credential leak via git | high | mitigate | `.env` ignored, `.env.example` placeholders only, `.dockerignore` excludes `.env`; `git check-ignore` acceptance. |
| T-03-03-03 | Information Disclosure | bucket enumeration | high | mitigate | No list command in store or routes (grep gate); list-denied assertion wired for AWS in 03-07. |
| T-03-03-04 | Denial of Service | 403-for-missing misread as a server error | medium | mitigate | 403 maps to null; unit spec; live proof in 03-07. |
| T-03-03-05 | Elevation of Privilege | container runs as root | low | mitigate | `USER node` in the Dockerfile. |
| T-03-03-06 | Tampering | unpinned base images | low | accept | `node:22-alpine` floats within Node 22 per SPEC-deployment; MinIO images are pinned to release tags. |
</threat_model>
